purpose: FTS retry preprocessor checks account statements (XAS) to detect whether a transfer already landed before retrying.
Payouts resolves and validates beneficiary contacts and fund accounts (bank account, VPA, card, wallet) from CFA.
Payouts initiates the bank transfer (HTTP POST /transfer) through FTS, which routes and dispatches it to partner banks.
Payouts checks/validates the merchant Virtual Account balance during payout creation and queued-payout processing.
ValidX resolves the beneficiary fund account from CFA during validation creation, before selecting a gateway. Skipped for reverse penny drop, where the VPA comes from the payer flow.

ValidX uses FTS as a validation gateway for pennydrop and paisadrop, transferring a small amount to the beneficiary and completing on the FTS webhook. FTS is also the fallback gateway when Citi or Slice penniless fails.
ValidX associates the merchant balance during validation creation so the validation fee can be charged to the correct funding account.
XAS consumes payout/reversal source events from the Payout Service (via SQS) to enrich statements by UTR/GRN/CMS matching.
